source: captured on the campaign host on 2026-11-05 before the timed campaign (superproject cf44eaa; /proc/cpuinfo, sysconf, uname, lscpu in host-lscpu.txt); engine commits are the gitlinks pinned by cf44eaa, from which every engine binary was built

host.cgroup: v1 memory controller; each timed stage alone in its own child group

host.sampling: one timed sample per flow; module stages one warm-up plus three measured repetitions
